verdict.rationale: The docs refer to a team and an organization: team API keys can be IP-allowlisted, individual keys can be locked to specific endpoints and formats, and URL-blocking policies are organization-controlled. This implies some team/org structure and key-level access scoping, but nothing shows user roles or sharing of scrapers. Missing for 10: sharing scrapers or jobs with teammates, organization member management, user-level role-based permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
